note: Provides one Views filter plugin, eref_node_titles (class EREFNodeTitles extends ManyToOne), registered on the node_field_data table via hook_views_data_alter(). It turns a node entity-reference relationship into an exposed dropdown of referenced node titles. No admin UI (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush. All medium/hard cases are grounded in real Views config / views data: introspection reads a view that uses the filter and the views-data registration; execution adds/removes the eref_node_titles filter in a live view's config and a verify inspects views.view.eref_eval. NOTE: a fully working filter also needs a node entity-reference relationship in the view; the verify checks the filter's presence/plugin_id in config, which is the module-specific, deterministically-checkable part.

evals.prompt: What Views filter does the entity_reference_exposed_filters module provide, what is its machine id, and on which Views table is it available?
evals.expected_output: It provides the filter 'Entity Reference Exposed Filters Node Titles' with id eref_node_titles (class EREFNodeTitles extends ManyToOne), registered on the node_field_data (Content) table via hook_views_data_alter().

evals.prompt: To use the entity_reference_exposed_filters 'node titles' filter in a View, what must the View already have, and is the filter exposed or not?
evals.expected_output: The View needs a standard node entity-reference relationship (a 'Content referenced from ...' relationship). The eref_node_titles filter is always exposed (its expose button is disabled) and marks itself broken if there is no valid relationship.

evals.prompt: Which extra options does the entity_reference_exposed_filters node-titles filter offer for controlling its list of options (e.g. sorting and published status)?
evals.expected_output: sort_by (nid/title), sort_order (ASC/DESC), sort_bundle_order (ASC/DESC), get_unpublished (Unpublished/Published/All), and get_filter_no_results (drop options that would return no results).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a View with machine name 'eref_eval'. Inspect its configuration and report the plugin id of the filter it uses from the entity_reference_exposed_filters module.
evals.expected_output: The eref_eval view's default display has a filter with plugin_id eref_node_titles (read via 'drush cget views.view.eref_eval' or by loading the view).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Views data for the node_field_data (Content) table and report the machine id of the filter that the entity_reference_exposed_filters module adds to it.
evals.expected_output: Views data for node_field_data includes a filter with id eref_node_titles (from hook_views_data_alter). Inspect via \Drupal::service('views.views_data')->get('node_field_data')['eref_node_titles'].

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a View 'eref_eval' (base table node_field_data) that does not yet use the entity_reference_exposed_filters filter. Add the eref_node_titles filter to its default display and save the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The eref_eval view's default display display_options.filters now contains an entry with plugin_id (and id) eref_node_titles, table node_field_data. (In a real site this filter also needs a node entity-reference relationship to render.)

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the View 'eref_eval' currently uses the entity_reference_exposed_filters eref_node_titles filter. Remove that filter from the view's default display and save the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The eref_eval view still exists but its default display display_options.filters no longer contains a filter with plugin_id eref_node_titles.
